payload.text: For hv, about the live tool: dc's WP12 (de97d29) deleted four legacy scripts, which broke hv's live ~/.local/bin/pplr (a symlink to this checkout's bin/pplr) for doctor and the icon commands for a few minutes. Restored in a4401b7 and verified (version and help, with no People access). vc amended D3, rule 3, rule 9 and eight ACs (a7a2493): no bin/ or lib/ file is deleted before WP13, when the live link moves to Rust. One deliberate change to live behaviour, forced by the critic gate on the restore: legacy setpicsfordirs now splits 'Surname, First' at the comma, so multi-word names work, as in Rust; single-word names are unchanged.
